dict.string: SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $att, ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image").@count > 0).@count > 0 OR SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $att, ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text").@count > 0).@count > 0 OR SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $att, ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url").@count > 0).@count > 0 OR SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $att, ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.vcard").@count > 0).@count > 0
